paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Domain distribution of our annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set (covering 12 domains in total).
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set, which encompasses 12 distinct domains. The largest segment, colored blue, represents "AI/NLP Research" at 24.3%, followed by "Econ. & Fin." in teal at 18.4%. The next largest segments are "History" and "Game&Anime," both at 8.2% and colored yellow and orange respectively. Other domains include "Daily Life" at 7.1% (light blue), "Med & Health" at 6.7% (green), "Science" also at 6.7% (red), "Pet & Animal" at 5.5% (orange), "Business" at 5.9% (dark red), "Law" at 5.1% (light red), "Geography" at 2.7% (dark yellow), and "Math" at 1.2% (dark green). Each domain is labeled with a line pointing to its corresponding slice, and percentages are explicitly shown next to each label. The chart is arranged with the largest segment starting at the top right and proceeding clockwise, with no visual emphasis such as exploded slices or bolding.
